howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: Please provide the required information below to complete your paylater application.

1.title: Create Request
1.desc: Fill the form with required documents and submit a request.

2.title: Linked Seller Notified
2.desc: The request is routed to the linked seller for review.

3.title: Seller Approves or Rejects
3.desc: Seller will either approve or reject the request. You'll be notified of the outcome.
